question: Which of the following musical instruments is played by Nandini and Ragini Shankar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Violin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The violin **is played by **Nandini and Ragini Shankar.**
 
• **Ragini and Nandini Shankar,** violinists based in Mumbai, have gained recognition for their remarkable skill in interpreting vocal music on the violin.
 
• The duo has collaborated with renowned artists across diverse genres and recently joined forces with **Decca Records US **to form their fusion ensemble, **Taraana**.
 
• **Ragini Shankar **has been honoured with the prestigious** Aditya Birla Kala Kiran Award** and the esteemed **Jashn-e-Youngistan Award**, bestowed upon her by the Vice President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The violin,** colloquially referred to as a fiddle, is a** wooden chordophone**, serving as the **smallest and highest-pitched instrument** (soprano) within the violin family.
 
• It holds significant importance across a diverse array of musical genres.
 
• Notably, violins feature prominently in Western classical music, whether as part of ensembles ranging from chamber groups to orchestras or as solo instruments.
 
• Additionally, they play a crucial role in various folk music traditions, including country, bluegrass, and jazz.
 
• Originating in 16th-century Italy, the violin underwent further modifications during the 18th and 19th centuries to enhance its sound quality and projection capabilities.
